# Profile banner artwork

Generated with the built-in image generation tool. Original reference: `assets/profile-banner.png`. Selected artwork: `assets/profile-banner-v2.png`.

## Final prompt

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished GitHub profile banner, very wide 3:1 panoramic composition, ideally 2400 x 800.
Input image: the existing profile banner is a thematic reference and edit target. Redesign its artwork substantially to make it much more refined and memorable while retaining its connection between software systems and imaginative pixel-art game worlds.
Creative direction: a beautifully art-directed indie game title-screen landscape, restrained cinematic pixel art with crisp deliberate pixel clusters, subtle atmospheric layers, sophisticated lighting. Midnight charcoal and deep desaturated navy matching GitHub dark mode, icy cyan highlights, a few warm amber windows.
Composition: wide, uncluttered panoramic composition. Across the left third, elegant thin architectural blueprint lines and a few large, simple wireframe structures emerge from darkness; these flow seamlessly into a small fully realized pixel-art coastal world across the center and right, with tiered stone terraces, pine silhouettes, one warmly lit developer's workshop, a distant lighthouse and a tiny fishing boat on a calm sea. Make the software-to-world transition feel like one landscape being constructed, not a collage of UI panels. A single clear, luminous small pixel cursor hovers above the transition near the center, modest scale, illuminating a short trail of precisely placed pixels. Strong dimensional depth and silhouette readability, elegant asymmetrical composition, substantial quiet dark sky above. The beautiful coastline and warm lights should feel handcrafted and inviting, not dystopian. Keep all important content inset from edges with generous breathing room. At 850 pixels displayed width, the major silhouettes and focal point must still read clearly.
Polish: professional game key art, precise pixel rendering, thoughtful light falloff, subtle reflection on water, clean large shape hierarchy. Prefer controlled detail and striking composition over visual noise.
Constraints: NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO border. No huge cursor, no floating dashboard windows, no dense code panels, no stock-tech circuitry foreground, no oversaturated neon, no purple glow, no excessive particles. Full bleed opaque artwork, not a mockup. Output one finished wide banner.
